mapper.insert: INSERT INTO places ( host_user_id, host_user_nickname, name, description, place_type, area_size, capacity, allows_small_dog, allows_medium_dog, allows_large_dog, provides_home_camera, provides_realtime_photo, provides_yard, provides_walk, other_options, hourly_price, nightly_price, status ) VALUES ( #{hostUserId}, #{hostUserNickname}, #{name}, #{description}, #{placeType}, #{areaSize}, #{capacity}, #{allowsSmallDog}, #{allowsMediumDog}, #{allowsLargeDog}, #{providesHomeCamera}, #{providesRealtimePhoto}, #{providesYard}, #{providesWalk}, #{otherOptions}, #{hourlyPrice}, #{nightlyPrice}, #{status} )
INSERT INTO place_addresses ( place_id, sido, sigungu, road_address ) VALUES ( #{placeId}, #{sido}, #{sigungu}, #{roadAddress} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, host_user_id AS hostUserId, name, host_user_nickname AS hostUserNickname, place_type AS placeType, area_size AS areaSize, hourly_price AS hourlyPrice, nightly_price AS nightlyPrice, average_rating AS averageRating, supports_hourly AS supportsHourly, supports_package AS supportsPackage, package_check_in_time AS packageCheckInTime, package_check_out_time AS packageCheckOutTime FROM places WHERE id = #{placeId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT id, host_user_nickname AS nickname, name, description, place_type AS placeType, allows_small_dog AS allowsSmallDog, allows_medium_dog AS allowsMediumDog, allows_large_dog AS allowsLargeDog, provides_home_camera AS providesHomeCamera, provides_realtime_photo AS providesRealtimePhoto, provides_yard AS providesYard, provides_walk AS providesWalk, hourly_price AS hourlyPrice FROM places WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' AND is_visible = TRUE AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT id, host_user_id AS hostUserId, host_user_nickname AS nickname, name, description, place_type AS placeType, area_size AS areaSize, capacity, allows_small_dog AS allowsSmallDog, allows_medium_dog AS allowsMediumDog, allows_large_dog AS allowsLargeDog, provides_home_camera AS providesHomeCamera, provides_realtime_photo AS providesRealtimePhoto, provides_yard AS providesYard, provides_walk AS providesWalk, other_options AS otherOptions, hourly_price AS hourlyPrice, nightly_price AS nightlyPrice, supports_hourly AS supportsHourly, supports_package AS supportsPackage, package_check_in_time AS packageCheckInTime, package_check_out_time AS packageCheckOutTime, status, is_visible AS visible FROM places WHERE id = #{placeId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE places SET supports_hourly = #{supportsHourly}, supports_package = #{supportsPackage}, package_check_in_time = #{packageCheckInTime}, package_check_out_time = #{packageCheckOutTime} WHERE id = #{placeId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE places p SET p.average_rating = ( SELECT COALESCE(AVG(rv.rating), 0) FROM reviews rv JOIN reservations rs ON rs.id = rv.reservation_id WHERE rs.place_id = p.id AND rv.deleted_at IS NULL ) WHERE p.id = #{placeId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT pa.sigungu FROM place_addresses pa JOIN places p ON p.id = pa.place_id WHERE p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.is_visible = TRUE AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY pa.sigungu
